summary: The J carpet is fixed. The q06 aisle now reads as a fine dark mauve-brown heather and matches the real c_27312 aisle almost exactly in colour and texture. There is no repeat, moire or stretching. Nothing else in the shell changed. The skeptic's remaining gap is the F and door cross-aisle carpets, which still use the flat procedural fabric layer that the J carpet just left, so they now stand out against J. The overall score stays 8.5; the improvement to the J carpet is offset by the F/door carpet inconsistency it exposes.

details.note: Unchanged: clean satin with seams every second window and no weave (s01, s05).
Unchanged. The F/J short bowl and LED pill are right. The PY/Y tub is right, but a light card remains on the tub floor.
Unchanged. The pleats read right at distance in s05; close-up contrast is half the photo's.
Unchanged. The half, closed and open states read right.

Fine heather with light flecks, in a mauve-brown that matches c_27312 within 2 levels per channel. Row-mean autocorrelation over 3 aisle bands shows no peak above 0.25, so no tile repeat. Far-aisle high-pass is 3.0-3.9 and the near aisle is 7.9, with no moire or shimmer. Isotropic, with no streaks. Slightly more texture contrast than the JPEG photo up close (7.5 vs 4.6), which is acceptable. Little J carpet is visible in the other J views (q07, s01, s05).
Unchanged navy heather (q16 aisle rgb 37,45,65, high-pass 9.6).
Still the flat procedural fabric layer. q03 F floor (800-845, 515-570) has high-pass 0.53, the same flat-paint look the J carpet had. Next to the new J heather the inconsistency is visible.
Unchanged. The viewing window is slightly short, and the housing has no gap to the bezel.
Unchanged grey vinyl in ra_door2floor (L101, high-pass 2.8), with low speckle. The brown door-bay carpet strip by the door is flat: high-pass 1.9 in ra_door2floor and 0.42 in s06.
